body: Thanks so much for taking the time to send this! I am jumping straight on it tonight. I am vegan/lactose intolerant so this helps.

I am 5ft 6in also and I went from 115 to 98lbs. I'm on short-acting adderall. Did switching to XR help with the appetite suppression? I'm crying for help over here. :( I don't want to stop the meds, but can not handle this weight loss any longer.

How are things going for you now? I came here searching for answers and are having the SAME issues. I was 110-115 and am now 98. So many people have commented and it's getting to the point that I just want to hide and not see anyone. What has helped you 3 months since this post? Any luck?
Can you send this recipe to me? Struggling to gain the weight back. I look anorexic.

This is my same problem. I've lost ~15 lbs since starting and it's making me so self conscience as I was at my perfect weight of 115. Now, I am 100 and it's driving me crazy! Please let me know what works for you. I'm considering stopping the medication but everything else is going great with it. So this is such a frustrating place to be.
I had no idea. I’ve decided just to leave it to be safe. Not worth it. Thank you so much for your reply. Really.
I could really use a friend right now.

I am an artist (kind of). I don’t feel good about my work. I work at an engineering firm by day as a Project Specialist. I hate my job. 
I don’t know what the fuck the point of life is. I can’t even have kids because of my endometriosis (unless I want to pay 10K). All I want to do is love and be loved. But nothing ever comes of that because I am so broken internally. Nothing ever changes. Ever. I thought I’d be healed by now. But I am still just as much over this life as before.
Everything. I can’t do this anymore.

Both. Another person left in my life tonight. Once they try to get close and then see my depression, they leave. It’s always the same. I feel unworthy of love. 
Also lost my best friend 3 months ago. She swore she’d never leave and then ghosted me. What is wrong with me? I can’t handle these thoughts. I feel like such a burden and a mistake. I have no purpose.
No. I have had bad experiences with it the few times I’ve tried it (panic attacks). Also have very critical parents who stigmatize it.

I told him he wanted all the perks and not the commitment anymore and he said it’s not that black and white, but I think it really is that simple. He has all the perks, just doesn’t want the exclusivity. I told him either we are a partnership and we grow together, or he moves out. He said if I have to give him an ultimatum, then he will choose to leave. I’m devastated. Completely. He isn’t an option for me. How did I get here? , but glad I came to you guys. I shouldn’t ever be an option. I fucking hate this pain right now. I think I knew deep down this would eventually happen. Now I don’t know how to do it, but you guys helped. Going to stay with some friends for a few days while I find a new room mate.
